title: Jamaican Shrimp Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together jerk seasoning and brown sugar (if using).
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and sprinkle with the jerk seasoning mixture.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
